scripts.dev: npm run build -w @private-ai-org/core && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @private-ai-org/server" "npm run dev -w @private-ai-org/web"
scripts.dev:chat: npm run build -w @private-ai-org/core && npm run build -w @private-ai-org/server && concurrently -k -n northstar,graph,chat -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start -w @private-ai-org/server" "npm run dev:board" "npm run dev:chat-ui"
scripts.hermes:smoke: npm run build -w @private-ai-org/core && npm run build -w @private-ai-org/server && node ./scripts/hermes-live.mjs smoke
scripts.build: npm run build -w @private-ai-org/core && npm run build -w @private-ai-org/server && npm run build -w @private-ai-org/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @private-ai-org/core && npm run typecheck -w @private-ai-org/core && npm run typecheck -w @private-ai-org/server && npm run typecheck -w @private-ai-org/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @private-ai-org/core && npm run build -w @private-ai-org/server && npm run test -w @private-ai-org/core && npm run test -w @private-ai-org/server
scripts.start: npm run build -w @private-ai-org/core && npm run build -w @private-ai-org/server && npm run start -w @private-ai-org/server
